plainEnglish.summary: An organisational assertion: the organisation states that it ran a usability test including participants with cognitive or mental health disabilities to look for misleading wording, artificial pressure and misdirection, and removed what it found.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Deceptive patterns work by exploiting the gap between what an interface appears to offer and what it does - a gap that is widest for users who read it literally.
